user.title: Set up Overhead Flights
user.description: Choose fixed search coordinates (a nearby public landmark is fine). While this dashboard is visible, the coordinates are sent to ADSB.lol at most once every 30 seconds. Aircraft identifiers go to Planespotters for photos. Planespotters requires a contact email or HTTPS URL in the API User-Agent. Setup does not make external requests.

data.photo_contact: Planespotters contact email or HTTPS URL

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Overhead Flights
reconfigure.description: Changing these settings reloads the integration. The coordinates are sent to ADSB.lol only while a dashboard requests updates.

data.photo_contact: Planespotters contact email or HTTPS URL

error.invalid_settings: Enter valid finite coordinates and a contact email or HTTPS URL.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Overhead Flights integration is supported.
